failure_summary.description: Several trajectories omit caching results, save a tool function instead of its returned result, use an undefined variable, or repeat a tool call rather than saving the assigned result.
Round trips are merged into an outbound search via arrival_date or omit the reverse-direction return search.
Agents regenerate or mishandle cached results, choose proximity without a proximity request, or fail to search the newly accepted category.
Agents substitute an attraction category or map a hotel amenity to the wrong field and omit an active neighborhood constraint.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already explicitly covers result assignment and caching, separate directional searches for round trips, cache-aware filtering and scope selection, and exact supported-value mapping. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing instructions rather than an unaddressed skill gap, so edits would duplicate content.
